## Summary

Describe the change and the user problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] Release build succeeds with signing disabled
- [ ] Property lists pass `plutil -lint`
- [ ] Camera frames are not retained, saved, logged, or uploaded
- [ ] Power assertions are released on all relevant paths
- [ ] User-visible documentation is updated in English and Chinese

## Privacy and security impact

Describe any changes to camera access, state publication, storage, networking, permissions, or dependencies.

## Performance impact

Provide before/after CPU, physical-footprint, and RSS results for changes that affect capture, Vision, timers, or UI. Include hardware, macOS, Xcode, build configuration, warm-up, duration, and commands. If not applicable, explain why.

## Screenshots or logs

Remove private information, serial numbers, UUIDs, account names, and unintended camera imagery.
